issues.title: Custom domain not loading
issues.problem_statement: The customer's custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, while the funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on the customer's own domain.

issues.title: Secure certificate (padlock) after connecting the domain
issues.problem_statement: Support noted that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after the domain connects; the customer did not report a missing padlock.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record at their domain registrar and added a CNAME record, using the target value shown in the FlexiFunnels domain settings, following support's guidance; support later saw the dashboard show the domain as connected and the customer confirmed the domain loads.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.

items.description: Customer deleted a second record for the www version and added a CNAME record for www with the same target value, following support's guidance, and confirmed both the main domain and the www version now load the funnel.
evidence: are loading our funnel now. Thank you!

items.description: Support explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
evidence: the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting

items.description: Support will check that the secure certificate has been issued and will message the customer if it has not.
evidence: I'll check tomorrow morning that the certificate has been issued, and I'll message you if it hasn't.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
